title: Tiles are not transparent and character is large relative to tileset

posts.author: MolarLisa
posts.body:
Hello! Obligatory this is my first time posting and I am very new to RPG Maker; I hope this is the correct thread for this kind of question. I am using RPG Maker VX Ace and I am attempting the One Map Challenge using the free version of this tileset:
Serene Village Revamped
and
Modern Interiors
for the character sprites by Limezu
My first problem is that when I place tiles from the folder, the supposedly translucent parts end up showing the black and blue (or white and gold depending on the lighting—this is a joke) parts, as seen in this image:
Spoiler
The file itself is a PNG so I'm assuming it has to be something on my end. Here is what the tileset looks like in the dataset (maybe the error is here?):
Spoiler
The other issue is that when I imported the same creator's character sprite sheet from another pack they made (modern interiors), the character ended up being way bigger relative to the tilesets provided (see image below). I tried looking through the comments or for a guide, but to no avail. Also i included a picture of what it is supposed to look like according to the creator
Spoiler
If you read this, thank you for your time :3
(i know it is against the rules to edit the body but i accidentally included irl info about me so i had to remove that screenshot lol)

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
MolarLisa said:
I am attempting the One Map Challenge using the free version of this tileset:
Serene Village Revamped
and
Modern Interiors
for the character sprites by Limezu
Click to expand...
Welcome!
When it comes to assets, there are two pieces of advice I always give:
1 - Practice making things with the assets that come with RPG Maker so you understand how they're supposed to work.
2 - When you
do
start adding/changing things, read the instructions. Help -> Contents -> Reference Materials -> Resource Standards tells you how everything should be formatted.
Your problem is that you have no ground. This goes back to point 1, and being familiar with how to make maps with the regular assets.
Ground tiles are on the A tab, and B+ tabs are above that. However, all of these tiles you've imported are on the B tab.
That means when you place the hills and stuff with transparent sections, there's nothing underneath them to see through the transparency.
You need ground tiles on the A tab to fill the map with, first.
MolarLisa said:
The other issue is that when I imported the same creator's character sprite sheet from another pack they made (modern interiors), the character ended up being way bigger relative to the tilesets provided (see image below). I tried looking through the comments or for a guide, but to no avail. Also i included a picture of what it is supposed to look like according to the creator
Click to expand...
Judging by the product pages you linked, this creator is clearly not an RPG Maker user. They're just releasing this stuff and relying on you to make it fit. Notice the part that says "RPG Maker compatible with software limitations."
If the characters are being created at the wrong size, then they are. And if there's not a different folder you're missing that has them sized for VX, then there isn't. (the product page does say it's available in 32x32, but that may only be the tiles)
You can resize them in an image editor, but of course that will make them look more pixelated.
You're best off getting assets that are specifically made for RPG Maker, unless you're proficient at using an image editor to make things match.

Thank you so much for your repsonse, it was incredibly helpful!! I did try reading the manual but I didn't really get it until you explained it like that. I will look through tutorials as well to see if I can get a better understanding of how the A tiles work as I eventually want to make my own. This applies to character sprites as well haha
In the meantime though, i sort of cheesed the file to fit one of the A tabs and i resized the characters by 50% (yes they are pixelated) which makes it look decently proportional! I really do want to complete the one map challenge with these assets as i think they are cute, but I def will be finding assets that are made with the program i have.
Also i wrote this post way late lol i must have confused a rule lol
Thanks again!!!
